Go on, cut it. That won't even buy smokes.
Take it, I can't be bothered.
If you need it, take it.
Cut away, be my guest. I've dropped a hundred of these.
Oh, that. Take it, I don't feel like getting dirty.
Go ahead. Wipe the knife afterwards, though, it stinks.
Hey... I'm the one who dropped it, you know. Split it?
Listen, that kill's mine. You could have asked.
Hold the knife. I spent half a mag on that thing.

Easy. The beast is mine, I put it down first. Let's do this like people.
Pal, I spent the rounds on it, not you. What do you say?
Stop. That's my kill. Put the knife away.
Hands off. I dropped it, I cut it.
Don't push it. Kill your own and gut that.
Knife away, I said. That's my catch.
Hey! I tracked that thing half a day. Step away from the carcass.
Not yours, don't touch it. The carcass is mine, and everything on it.
Wait! Don't, please. It's my first one like this...
Look, I know you're a serious man... but I got this one. Leave it, yeah?
I just need to clear a debt... please don't cut it.
Don't, okay? I know it's nothing to you. It would last me a month.
Wait, man... I barely took it down. Let me at least keep this.
Please. I'm not asking for much. Just this one thing.
You cut clean? Do it right and I'll pay.
I can't be bothered. Cut it neatly and we'll talk.
My hands aren't what they were. Cut it clean, don't spoil it, and I'll pay for the work.
I've no time to fiddle with a knife. Take it off whole and I won't shortchange you.
It's a rare part, you cut it, you don't tear it. Can you? Then go ahead, I'll thank you for it.
Cut it, but don't ruin the goods. I'll add a bit for a clean cut.
That's $name's kill. He'll be right over.
Easy, $name dropped that one. Ask first.
Hey, that's $name's catch. He's around here somewhere, he'll be right over.
Wait, $name put that one down. You could wait for the owner.
Put the knife away. It's $name's beast, and he'll want a word.
Don't cut it yet. $name dropped that one, he just stepped away for a minute.
Its owner's gone. Take it, it'll only rot.
Take it. He won't need it now.
The owner's dead. Cut it, no use letting it go to waste.
Don't wait for anyone. Whoever dropped it has had his share. Take it.
Go on, take it. A dead man has no use for a trophy, the living do.
Pity about the man. Cut it, at least something good comes of it.
Fine. I'll remember.
You could have shared.
Ah... fine. Ask next time.
You cut it after all. Well, call it that I owe you... no, you owe me.
I asked nicely. Fine, forget it.
All right, all right. Just not behind my back next time.
Look at you. This isn't over.
So you cut it. The Zone's small, we'll meet again.
Remember what I said? I remember what you did.
You picked the wrong man to cut from. Fine, for now.
Cheeky. The Zone is a small place, we'll meet.
Nicely done. At someone else's expense. Fine, we'll talk later.
How could you... fine. Whatever.
Take it then. No arguing with your kind.
Eh. What's the use arguing with you... Take it.
I see. The strong are always right. Cut it.
Well... I didn't really hope, to be honest.
Oh, to hell with it. I'll find another beast.
Your way then. No money for you.
You cut it yourself, then. Count me out.
No deal is no deal. Don't expect any money.
You took it, you enjoy it. I'm taking my word back.
Fine. No asking, no paying.
You cut in silence, so leave in silence. I'm not paying.
What people. While I counted my rounds, $who cut up my kill. I saw that face.
Dropped a beast, walked up, and there's $who with a knife. Right in front of me.
Watch your kills, guys. $who is going through other people's carcasses.
Does anyone know where $who came from? Cut from my carcass without blinking.
Warning: $who cuts other people's trophies. The carcass was mine, and so was the cut.
While I was dealing with the beast, $who took everything valuable off it. That's how it is.
Saw it myself: $name made the kill and $who cut the trophy.
Tell $name not to look for his trophy. $who took it, I saw.
Word for $name: while he stepped away, $who cut his catch. I was standing right there.
$name, where are you? $who cut up your beast, I was right there.
Saw it with my own eyes: $who took the trophy from under $name's nose.
For the record: $name killed the beast, $who did the cutting. Decide for yourselves who's to blame.

Someone took my trophy while I looked away. Well, well.
Walk up to the carcass, nothing. Cut off neatly. Wish I knew who.

If anyone saw who cut that carcass behind my back, let me know.

Suit yourself.
Nothing to say? Fine.
All right, go. We'll meet again.
Then go. I'll remember.

Nothing to say? Then neither have I.
So, about that beast?

Later, later!
Not now!
Not now, can't you see what's going on!
No time! We'll finish later!
No time for haggling! Later!
Watch out! Later, all of it later!
Put the weapon away and we'll talk.
Lower that weapon. We need a word.
Put the gun away or I won't talk.

Put the iron away. We'll talk like people.
Clean work. Here, as agreed.

A straight cut, well done. Here's yours.
Good work. Here, I won't cheat you.
Neat. I might even say thanks. Here.

Thanks for stepping back. This is for your trouble.
That was decent of you. Here.
You didn't argue, I respect that. Here, for the road.
Now that's decent. Take it, don't refuse.
Didn't expect that. Fine, this is for understanding.
Not everyone would. Here, you earned it.
I dropped that beast. Can we work something out?
Listen, the beast is mine. Let's not quarrel - shall we split it?
Hold the knife. I put it down, so we need to talk.
My kill, my trophy. What do you say?
Leave the carcass. I put it down, so the trophy is mine. Objections?
Stay where you are. That's my catch, and this will be short.

Listen... I don't want a quarrel. But I need this trophy badly. Can we agree?
I know you can take whatever you want. But maybe leave it to me? Let's agree.
I won't bother with it myself. Cut it clean and I'll pay.
I've no time to fiddle with a knife. Cut it clean and I won't shortchange you.
This takes fine work. Do it right and I'll pay.
You cut up my kill. Anything to say?
So you cut it. Well, what do we do now?
You cut the carcass without asking. How do you mean to settle it?
You took my trophy. Give it back or pay.

You cut what's mine. Now either return it or pay up.
You cut it... I wasted all day on that thing. Leave me something, yeah?
You already cut it... I tracked it half a day. Give me something in return, yeah?
Ah, you cut it anyway. Maybe you could make it up to me a bit?
You cut it without asking. Fine, let's settle this.
Cut it yourself without waiting for me. Well, shall we settle up?
Without asking, then. Fine, let's do it properly.
That was yours? I didn't know. Here.
So it was yours? I didn't know. Take it.
Sorry, pal, I didn't know it was yours. Here.
Your kill, was it? Who knew. Let's split it somehow.
So it was yours. All right, let's split it fairly.
Ah, yours... I didn't notice. Maybe we split it?
First come, first served. I'll sell it if you want.
Whoever cuts first gets the catch. But I can sell it if you need.
I got there first. So the trophy is mine. But I'll let it go for a price.
What did you say? Keep walking.
What? I didn't hear anything. Keep walking.
I don't need talks like that. Move along.
It's gone already.
What do you want?
Got it cut? Hand it over, as agreed.
Clean work. Here, as agreed.
Got it cut? Hold on, I'm coming.
Don't leave, I'm on my way.
Coming, coming, don't leave.
One second, I'm nearly there.
Stay put, I'm almost there.
Wait, don't run off, I'm paying.
[$n RU, $c%]
You again. Last time you settled up fair.
We meet again. You paid without any talk back then, I remember.
Familiar face. A man can do business with you.
You again. That last deal was square.
You again. You let me have my share that time, I haven't forgotten.
Ah, you. Last time went decently.
I know you, you gave me my take.
You again. I remember that time kindly.
You again. Last time you walked off with mine and didn't pay.
Well, an old friend. I still owe you for that piece.
You again. You've robbed me once already.
Look who it is. You still owe me from last time.
That's it, you asked for this.
Not the easy way, then? Fine.
Bad call. There's nobody around to see.
That's the last time you rob me.
That is it, the talk is over.
Right, brace yourself.

I cut it, you get a share.

Forget it.
Here, take it.
Here's your share.

I'll pay a share, give it back.
Keep it, but give me my share.

Have it your way.
Now that's talking. Here, for your trouble.

Fine, we're done.
I'll remember.
Here. No hard feelings.
Fair enough. Here's the money.
It's yours. Take care.
Take care.

Damn you! I asked you not to!
So that's how it is? Fine, I'll remember.

You made your choice. I won't forget it.

Cut the $part properly and we're square.

Cut it, we have enough. No point arguing over nothing.

Cut it, cut it, don't sweat it.

All right. But don't do it again.

Ah, fine. Freedom, after all.
You're a sly one. Fine, we'll settle up.

Noted. Once.
